skills.name: audit-content-library
skills.description: Audit the current content library before Article Brief approval and again before chief-editor review. Use read-only Flexim access, a complete export, or an explicit declaration of an empty library to assess semantic overlap, gaps, competing drafts, update opportunities, and internal links. Return an evidence-linked portfolio decision and differentiation contract. Do not mutate articles, CMS, or the editorial contract.
headings: 6. Hand off to the Article Brief
skills.description_zh: 在 Article Brief 批准前及主编复核前审查现有内容库，依据 Flexim 只读访问、完整导出或明确的空库声明，评估语义重叠、内容缺口、竞争草稿、更新机会及内部链接，输出带证据的内容组合决策与差异化约定；不修改文章、CMS 或编辑约定。

skills.name: audit-eeat
skills.description: Audit an article's claim support, demonstrated first-hand experience, expertise depth, author and publisher trust surface, and author-only evidence gaps without assigning an E-E-A-T score. Use as an independent gate after edit-article, especially for named-author, review, case-study, advice, comparison, YMYL, AI-assisted, or first-person content. Distinguish a required evidence interview from a non-blocking recommended interview that would add concrete author contribution or information gain, route gaps to research, structure, rephrasing, deletion, or interview, and produce traceable patches only from supplied answers. Do not invent experience, credentials, sources, metrics, biographies, or ranking claims.
headings: S2. Audit evidence inside the package
skills.description_zh: 独立审查文章的主张证据、亲身经验、专业深度、作者及出版方可信信息与作者专属证据缺口，不给 E-E-A-T 打分。适用于编辑后及署名、评测、案例、建议、比较、YMYL 或第一人称内容，区分必需与建议访谈，并仅依据已提供回答形成可追溯修订；不得编造经验、资历、来源或排名承诺。

skills.name: audit-paragraph-structure
skills.description: Audit and rewrite paragraph, list, and table structure in articles, documentation, essays, and technical prose. Use as a required independent gate after edit-article, or whenever every paragraph must be checked for one governing thought, scanability, informative openings, sufficient development, and clean endings, while lists remain linked, parallel, ordered, grouped, and non-repetitive. Preserve approved meaning, claims, sources, and author voice. Do not use for article strategy, new research, or publishing.
skills.description_zh: 审查并重写文章、文档、论文和技术文字的段落、列表及表格结构，逐段检查中心思想、可扫读性、信息开头、充分展开和收尾，保持列表关联、平行、顺序、分组及不重复。作为编辑后的独立检查，保留已批准含义、主张、来源和作者声音；不负责文章策略、新研究或发布。

skills.name: audit-tone-honesty
skills.description: Audit and selectively rewrite tone in editorial, technical, marketing, and commercial copy by separating false performance, honest speech, and justified play. Use as a required independent gate after edit-article, or to check invented author voice, production-language leakage, hidden motives, false intimacy, pressure, flattery, shame, unsupported confidence, fabricated stories, honest limits, care, and demonstration. Permit play only inside a clear frame with independent value. Do not replace full editing, fact-checking, E-E-A-T audit, or the Article Brief.
headings: 1. Fix the editorial and tone contracts
skills.description_zh: 审查并选择性修改编辑、技术、营销及商业文案的语气，区分虚假表演、诚实表达和有明确框架及独立价值的趣味表达。检查虚构作者声音、内部制作语言泄漏、隐藏动机、虚假亲密、施压、奉承、羞辱、无依据自信和编造故事；不替代完整编辑、事实核查、E-E-A-T 审查或 Article Brief。

skills.name: audit-useful-action
skills.description: Define the text's useful action in the reader's world and verify that the title, opening, sections, examples, product block, and conclusion lead to the promised change. Use as a required independent gate after edit-article, or when choosing an angle, checking an Article Brief, or making a focused commercial-copy revision. Do not replace full editing, paragraph or evidence audits, or change the editorial contract without explicit approval.
skills.description_zh: 明确文章希望帮助读者完成的实际行动，检查标题、开头、章节、示例、产品介绍和结尾是否推动所承诺的改变。适用于编辑后的独立检查、选题角度、Article Brief 审查及针对性商业文案修订；不替代完整编辑、结构或证据审查，未经明确批准不改变编辑约定。

skills.name: chief-editor-review
skills.description: Resolve an article's independent editorial audits against its approved Article Brief, sources, author evidence, product state, and current reader Markdown. Use after edit-article and the five independent audits, or when author answers, user amendments, or final-reader findings reopen a locked decision. Accept, reject, or defer every material finding, apply only traceable edits, classify change impact, rerun only affected gates, decide explicitly on recommended author interviews, and lock meaning before visual work. Do not perform the independent audits, invent evidence, produce visuals, mutate CMS, or publish.
skills.description_zh: 在文章编辑及五项独立审查后，由主编依据获批 Article Brief、来源、作者证据、产品状态和读者版 Markdown 处理各项发现，逐一接受、拒绝或暂缓重大意见，实施可追溯修改、评估影响并重跑受影响检查，明确访谈决策并在视觉工作前锁定含义；不代做独立审查、编造证据、制作视觉或发布。

skills.name: cms-draft-handoff
skills.description: Create or update an explicitly authorized private article draft in Flexim CMS after final integration and a context-free cold-reader review are ready, then read the full record back and verify normalized Markdown, relations, metadata, and unpublished state. Use when a user asks to save, upload, import, hand off, or update an article draft in Flexim CMS. Keep article completion and topic status separate from verified draft storage. Do not publish, delete, silently overwrite an ambiguous record, invent missing payload fields, or treat a successful write without read-back as complete.
headings: Hand off a private draft to CMS
skills.description_zh: 在最终整合和无上下文读者复核完成后，将明确授权的文章保存或更新为 Flexim CMS 私有草稿，回读完整记录以核对规范化 Markdown、关系、元数据及未发布状态。区分文章完成与已验证的草稿存储；不发布、删除、模糊覆盖或编造缺失字段，写入成功后仍须回读。

skills.name: cold-reader-review
skills.description: Review a finished article as a fresh reader with no production context. Use after final-integration-check and before a final package or private CMS draft when a clean agent must judge title promise, comprehension, coherence, useful action, visible product honesty, media, and leaked internal language. See only reader-visible surfaces; do not fact-check, edit, read repositories or CMS, inspect an Article Brief, or publish.
headings: Review an article as a cold reader
skills.description_zh: 以不了解制作背景的新读者视角复核成稿，检查标题承诺、理解难度、连贯性、实际用途、产品表达真实性、媒体和内部语言泄漏。用于最终整合后及交付或私有 CMS 草稿前，仅看读者可见内容；不核查事实、编辑、读取仓库或 CMS、查看 Article Brief 或发布。

skills.name: draft-article
skills.description: Discover the author's intended direction and material, structure a proposed Article Brief, or write an evidence-linked draft from an approved Brief. Use after topic analysis and before direction approval or full drafting, including when sources alone could support a generic article. Resolve author discovery before classifying remaining evidence needs; preserve permitted voice without inventing experience. Do not use to edit a final draft or publish.
skills.description_zh: 探索作者的意图与素材，拟定 Article Brief，或按已批准 Brief 撰写带证据关联的草稿。适用于选题分析后、方向批准或完整写作前，先完成作者信息发现再判断剩余证据需求，保留允许的作者声音且不编造经验；不用于编辑最终草稿或发布。

skills.name: edit-article
skills.description: Edit, audit, shorten, or polish an existing article or long-form draft from meaning and evidence through structure, tone, sentences, words, and rhythm. Use for manual review and automatic article pipelines in any language when a draft must remain faithful to an approved Article Brief, claim permissions, sources, product state, and assigned author voice, or when internal keyword, Brief, audit, MCP, schema, validation, or workflow language has leaked into reader copy. Do not use to invent an article from a topic or publish it.
skills.description_zh: 依据含义、证据、结构、语气、句子、用词和节奏编辑、审查、缩短或润色已有长文。适用于各语言的人工审稿与自动文章流程，确保符合获批 Article Brief、主张权限、来源、产品状态及作者声音，并清除泄漏到读者文案的关键词、审查、MCP、结构或工作流内部语言；不从主题凭空创作或发布。

skills.name: final-integration-check
skills.description: Verify a chief-editor-locked article after visual integration and before independent final reader review. Check final Markdown, media, captions, alt text, author and publisher metadata, and SEO fields together; validate a CMS draft payload only when that is the requested destination. Return a portable article package or draft payload with a clean cold-reader dispatch, or a precise blocker. Do not reopen editorial strategy without cause, create assets, mutate CMS, or publish.
skills.description_zh: 在主编锁定文章、完成视觉整合后及独立读者复核前，联合核对最终 Markdown、媒体、图注、替代文本、作者和出版方元数据及 SEO 字段；仅在目标为 CMS 草稿时校验其请求数据。交付可迁移文章包、草稿数据与清晰的读者复核交接，或说明具体阻碍；不无故重开策略、创建素材、修改 CMS 或发布。

skills.name: load-author-voice
skills.description: Resolve an assigned author and obtain the complete Markdown voiceProfile through recommended read-only Flexim access, or validate a transient provided profile or existing authorVoiceHandoff when Flexim is unavailable or does not contain the complete profile. Use before drafting or editing when an Article Brief, CMS entry, or user assigns an author or requires that author's voice. Record provenance, verify the exact author-profile relationship, and constrain the profile to voice, composition, vocabulary, rhythm, and format adaptation. Do not require a Flexim profile when a complete safe portable input exists, store profiles in the repository, write article copy, treat a voice profile as evidence, or mutate CMS.
skills.description_zh: 确定指定作者并通过建议的 Flexim 只读访问取得完整 Markdown voiceProfile；无法取得时校验临时提供的完整资料或既有 authorVoiceHandoff。写作或编辑前核对作者与资料的准确关系并记录来源，将资料限定用于声音、结构、词汇、节奏及格式适配；不把声音资料当事实证据、存入仓库、撰写正文或修改 CMS。

skills.name: render-mermaid-infographic
skills.description: Render or preflight one approved Mermaid infographic locally after visual-storytelling has supplied a complete compatible media brief. Use for an explicit Mermaid production request or as an optional media-production worker; never use it to decide that an article needs a diagram, install dependencies silently, integrate assets, access CMS, or publish.
skills.description_zh: 在 visual-storytelling 提供完整且兼容的已批准媒体需求后，于本地渲染或预检单个 Mermaid 信息图。适用于明确的 Mermaid 制作请求或可选媒体制作任务；不决定文章是否需要图、不静默安装依赖、不整合素材、访问 CMS 或发布。

skills.name: run-seo-writing-workflow
skills.description: Coordinate or resume SEO Writers from an onboarding prompt, topic selection, or portfolio decision through author discovery, an approved Article Brief, specialist work, independent reviews, and a final article package or explicitly authorized private CMS draft. Resolve author intent before fixing a new direction or drafting, preserving source context, title authority, evidence boundaries, and checkpoint handoffs. Use for the complete article workflow or a scoped revision batch. Keep Flexim optional for writing and never publish.
headings: 4. Prepare and approve the Article Brief
10. Final integration and independent cold reader
Choose where to save the finished article
skills.description_zh: 统筹或恢复 SEO Writers 文章流程，从初始需求、选题或内容组合决策，经作者发现、获批 Article Brief、专项制作和独立审查，到最终文章包或明确授权的 CMS 私有草稿。确定新方向及写作前先澄清作者意图，保留来源背景、标题权限、证据边界和检查点交接；写作可不依赖 Flexim，绝不发布。

skills.name: visual-storytelling
skills.description: Plan, brief, audit, and integrate the visual narrative of a chief-editor-approved article or long-form draft. Use after editorial validation when locked text needs meaningful screenshots, diagrams, charts, tables, illustrations, photos, video, code examples, captions, alt text, or production briefs. Turn an approved Article Brief, decision log, and reader Markdown into a minimal evidence-safe media plan, select narrative compositions from the bundled template library, and separate template logic from brand styling. Do not reopen editorial strategy, add decorative images by quota, or fabricate proof.
skills.description_zh: 为主编批准的长文规划、说明、审查并整合视觉叙事，涵盖有意义的截图、图示、图表、表格、插画、照片、视频、代码、图注及替代文本。依据获批 Brief、决策记录和读者版 Markdown 制定精简且有证据支持的媒体计划，从模板库选择叙事布局并区分模板逻辑与品牌样式；不重开编辑策略、按配额添加装饰图或伪造证据。
